For P1 in rollout 2, the failure was caused by an unparsable reveal action at turn 4 (malformed JSON with a duplicate 'type' key); the model recovered by sharing PF1's content in a say action at turn 7, but the settlement did not credit PF1. To improve robustness, either (a) make the reveal parser more tolerant of minor JSON errors so partially-formed reveals are still captured, or (b) add a fallback in the settlement logic that recognizes fact content stated in say actions when a prior reveal attempt failed. No changes to agent personalities or shared_context are needed—both A2 and A3 consistently disclose their facts promptly when their reveal actions parse correctly.
